scripts.build: tsc -b packages/*/tsconfig.build.json packages/extensions/*/tsconfig.build.json services/*/tsconfig.build.json --force && pnpm --filter @axl/web build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:generated
scripts.install:cli: pnpm install && pnpm build && node scripts/install-cli.ts
scripts.relay:check: cd services/relay && mix format --check-formatted && mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix credo --strict && mix dialyzer && mix deps.audit
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 packages/*/test/*.test.ts packages/extensions/*/test/*.test.ts services/*/test/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts
